injuries.detail: out
Head coach Joel Quenneville said Friday that Moore (lower body) is still "a ways from skating," Patrick Present of The Hockey News reports.
Poehling (knee) is expected to miss 6-8 weeks with an MCL sprain.
Terry (hip) was moved from the non-roster list to long-term injured reserve Wednesday, Zach Cavanagh of The Sporting Tribune reports.
Carrick is being evaluated for a mid-body injury, according to Heather Engel of NHL.com on Tuesday.
Zucker (abdomen) practiced on the third line Monday and is on track to make his regular-season debut Wednesday against the Flyers.
Danforth (upper body) missed Monday's practice, according to Justin Alpert and Jourdon LaBarber of the Sabres' official site.
Dahlin (upper body) told reporters he "thinks he'll be ready" for Wednesday's clash with Philadelphia.
Lyon (upper body) had a setback in his recovery and is without a timeline to return, the team announced Thursday.
Grzelcyk (lower body) suffered a "flare-up" and could be out for at least "a few days," head coach Lindy Ruff told Rachel Lenzi of The Buffalo News on Tuesday.
Timmins (lower body) doesn't have a timeline for his return yet, according to Heather Engel of NHL.com on Tuesday.
ir-nr
Backlund (upper body) is day-to-day, according to Eric Francis of Sportsnet on Tuesday.
ir
Huberdeau (hip) was placed on injured reserve Monday, per Pat Steinberg of QR Calgary 770 AM.
ir
Head coach Rod Brind'Amour said Sunday that Jankowski has ben sent back to Raleigh to have his lower-body injury assessed, Walt Ruff of the Hurricanes' official site reports.
Jarvis (shoulder) said Friday that he plans to travel with the Hurricanes during their upcoming five-game road trip, Ryan Henkel of The Hockey News reports.
ir
Nikishin (contract dispute) is on the Hurricanes' injured, non-roster list, per the NHL media site Wednesday.
